name: Ganesh Benzoplast
tagline: A chequered governance history culminating, as of the most recent post, in the company selling off the very tank/terminal business that was its core investment thesis
business_overview: Chemical storage, tank-farm and liquid-logistics operator (JNPT, Goa, Cochin terminals) with a separate chemicals manufacturing subsidiary; had been pursuing an LPG import terminal JV at JNPA before that JV was cancelled.
fundamentals_narrative: Low leverage is the only clean positive. Revenue is actually declining (-4.99%), and the headline fundamentals don't capture the real story, which is governance: a subsidiary-level fraud finding, an NCLT creditor action, a ballooning inter-corporate-deposit settlement at a 36% p.a. rate, and — as of the most recent forum post (2026-09-29) — the company selling off its core liquid-storage tank business at JNP, Goa and Cochin on a slump-sale basis.
sentiment_summary: Long, eventful thread. 2024: a fraud issue surfaced at the chemicals subsidiary, capex costs for the flagship LPG terminal project escalated repeatedly (Rs 400-450 Cr → Rs 750 Cr) with no clear explanation, and creditors dragged the chemicals division into NCLT. 2025: an inter-corporate deposit ballooned into a large settlement at usurious (36% p.a.) rates, a fresh FIR was filed against company directors/KMPs, and — the single biggest blow — the BW LPG JV partnership was cancelled, with one long-term holder stating the original thesis was "completely negated." 2026: JNPT lease rental surged 8-10x (Rs 2-3 Cr → Rs 24 Cr), and on 2026-09-29 (two days before this scan) the company announced it is selling its core tank/terminal business entirely.
community_signal: Multiple long-time trackers (Dhruv_Bajaj, ashwind, StonePitbull, novice2014) documented each governance event in real time; one investor (learner1) exited 100% of his holding on the JV cancellation news in 2025-05, calling it a thesis-nullifying event. Sentiment has deteriorated from cautious optimism (2024 concall-driven turnaround hope) to open skepticism by 2026.
bse_notes: 2024: subsidiary-level fraud finding, NCLT creditor action against the chemicals division. 2025-05: FIR registered against company Directors and KMPs over an inter-corporate-deposit matter. 2026-03: JNPT lease rental increase ~8-10x. 2026-09-29: BSE/exchange notification of a slump-sale of the core liquid-storage tank business (JNP, Goa, Cochin) plus the ILSL Rail Logistics subsidiary stake.
bull_case: Strategic JNPT land asset (lease valid to 2047) retained even after the LPG JV cancellation
One contrarian recent view (Amit2saxena, 2025-12) took a U-turn to constructive after initially avoiding the stock, citing deep value
bear_case: Subsidiary-level fraud finding (2024) plus a fresh FIR against company Directors/KMPs (2025-05) — a serious, repeated governance pattern
The flagship LPG terminal JV (BW LPG) was cancelled in 2025-05 — a long-term holder explicitly called the original investment thesis "completely negated"
Capex cost estimates for that now-cancelled project nearly doubled (Rs 400-450 Cr → Rs 750 Cr) with no clear management explanation — a credibility problem independent of the cancellation
JNPT lease cost shock (8-10x increase) materially raises the carrying cost of the company's remaining strategic asset

Most recent news (2026-09-29, days before this scan): the company is selling off its core tank/storage terminal business — the business the original VP thread thesis ("cash rich chemical storage/tank king") was built on — on a slump-sale basis
verdict_headline: The core tank/terminal business this thesis was built on is now being sold off, layered on top of a subsidiary-level fraud finding and an FIR against company KMPs — HIGH CAUTION, hard neither
verdict_reasoning: HIGH CAUTION applied: subsidiary-level fraud (2024) + FIR against Directors/KMPs (2025) + a cancelled flagship JV + an 8-10x lease-cost shock is a serious, repeated governance pattern, even without a confirmed SEBI/going-concern finding that would escalate to EXCLUDE/AVOID.

The most decisive fact is the most recent one: a 2026-09-29 slump-sale of the company's core liquid-storage tank business fundamentally changes (or ends) the original 'tank king' investment thesis regardless of any four-box mechanics — thesis_fit is neither on business-model-discontinuity grounds, not just score.
Conviction Low (not Low-Medium) given the severity and recency of the governance pattern plus the core-business divestiture.
red_flag_reason: Subsidiary-level fraud finding (2024), FIR against company Directors/KMPs (2025-05), cancelled flagship JV, and a 2026-09-29 slump-sale of the company's core tank/terminal business — the asset the original thesis was built on.

four_box.note: Core business being divested as of the most recent post; thesis no longer applicable regardless of mechanical scoring
